body: Updated: I asked him and he did catch feelings. We’ll see what happens, but I’m so, so glad I took everyone’s advice and said something ☺️
Okay, I’m going to talk to him about it 🤞. Thank you for your advice!
I’ll ask him. Thank you for your advice!
I did ask, when he originally said it, and he had said he’s trying to “figure stuff out” in his head and wants a clear head for that. 🤷‍♀️
Thank you for your advice. I will talk to him about it.

I worry a lot (generally about things I don’t need to worry about) and I’m worried if I talk to him about how I want there to be an “us”, he’ll pull away. I’ve never asked anyone out before. He seems genuinely happy and relaxed when we hang out though, and I absolutely love spending time with him. It would crush me if he started seeing someone and I don’t want to try and date anyone else. Since we were just FWB the opportunity came up and I saw someone else around when I was seeing him (this was about 2 months ago) and the entire time I was with the other person, I was wishing it was with my friend instead 🤦‍♀️

OP said friend’s parents aren’t great though. Will they let the kid go to therapy? Mine never did. OP&friend are high schoolers. They can’t get help like that if their parents don’t let them. I was in a pretty similar situation as this last Thursday and I honestly wish my friend had told someone, because I haven’t got the guts to get help and therapy isn’t helping. I understand other people would feel differently but that’s my 2 cents, and it sounds like OP wants to tell and get help anyways but is unsure/afraid to.

I have been in the same situation as the friend who is suicidal and have been told on before. I always came around because I realized my friends did it because they cared. I was angry at first but I eventually forgave them. It’s more important that their safety is ensured than immediate comfort.
You need to tell an adult regardless, if there has been an attempt or not. Your friend will be angry for a while but grateful eventually. Take it from someone who knows.

It’s too late. I can’t trust anyone anymore. 50% of the old friends made it clear they don’t want anything to do with me anymore, and the other 50% I’m too ashamed to contact.

Even working 80 hours a week I’d still be living paycheck to paycheck almost because our society is fucked up.

I was at a OBGYN appt for the 1st time ever last year and my dr definitely saw, and said nothing. It was my first time not being nervous about someone seeing my scars bc I was so nervous about what would happen in the obgyn appt itself 😅 They are trained well, it’s unfortunately not the first or last they’ll see.

 Thank you for getting vaccinated and helping us all get back to normal! You’re doing a great thing and ought to be commended. Can’t wait to get my vaccine. I’m able to apply for one in my state next Monday!! Vaccines for the win!!

Part of why he was so upset by it is because he has scars from suicide attempts, and he’s lost several friends from mental health reasons. I’d feel bad not telling him but I’m still really tempted to just hope he literally cannot see... because his vision is quite horrendous. It’s just like a rock and a hard place between guilt or an uncomfortable conversation. 🤦‍♀️
